sentences.japanese: 隅にいた男の人が夫に話しかけた。
sentences.english: The man in the corner addressed himself to the husband.

sentences.japanese: 既婚女性が家や夫や子供たちの面倒を見ることがどんなことか、彼女は知っていた。
sentences.english: She knew what it was like for married women to look after houses, husbands and children.

sentences.japanese: 完璧な夫にまだ出会ったことがない。
sentences.english: I have yet to find a perfect husband.

sentences.japanese: 家の中で喧嘩がある時は、いつでも私の夫は私ではなく、自分の母の側につく。
sentences.english: When we have a family argument, my husband always sides with his mother instead of me.

sentences.japanese: リンダの夫は彼女を裏切っていた。
